import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import *
import imgtool
from collections import Counter
rng = random.Random(1234)
def T(name, fib, nq=300):
    q = [fib[i][0] for i in range(0, len(fib), max(1,len(fib)//nq))][:nq] + [rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(50)]
    t0=time.time(); ok, img = check_fib(name, fib, q, verbose=True)
    nodes = imgtool.find_nodes(img)
    print('   %.1fs types %s rows %d cells %d dict %d ni %d' % (time.time()-t0, dict(Counter(n['type'] for n in nodes)),
          sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']), sum(img['cells']), len(img['bitmaps']), len(img['nexthops'])))
# 8192 G0-only prefixes (lengths 0..16)
seen=set(); fib=[]
while len(fib)<8192:
    L=rng.randint(0,16); a=ref.mask(rng.getrandbits(128),L)
    if (a,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((a,L)); fib.append((a,L,rng.randint(0,4194302)))
T('g0-only-8192', fib)
# 8192 prefixes all of length 16
seen=set(); fib=[]
